attempts.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (RHEL 9.8) via /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/90-complexity.conf with minlen=12 and minclass=3, enforced through the existing pam_pwquality.so entries in system-auth/password-auth. Verified enforcement (reject short passwords, reject passwords with fewer than 3 character classes, accept valid 12+ char/3-class passwords) both before and after a full reboot of node1, confirmed via changed boot_id and fresh uptime.
